canonical.title: Strongly Connected Components — Kosaraju's Algorithm
canonical.sourceFilePath: 13. Graphs/6. Other Algorithms/02. Strongly Connected Components.cpp

narrative.title: Counting the Closed Courier Loops
narrative.scenario: A courier's one-way route map hides closed guilds: sets of hubs where every hub can reach every other by following the arrows. Management wants the number of such mutually-reachable guilds. Two passes do it — log when each hub finishes its exploration, then replay the map with every arrow reversed, popping hubs in decreasing finish order and counting each fresh exploration as one guild.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer V (vertices 0..V-1) and an adjacency list adj where adj[i] lists the destinations of vertex i's one-way edges.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of strongly connected components.

testCases.explanation: 0, 1, 2 cycle among themselves; 3 and 4 stand outside as singletons.
A single grand cycle makes all four vertices one component.

hintLevels: Level 1: Within a guild every arrow round-trips; between guilds the arrows only flow one way.
Level 2: Finish-time order + edge reversal collapses each guild while separating the flow between them.
Level 3: Second-pass DFS roots in decreasing finish order — every new root is one more SCC.
